instructions: Pull 4 stalks off the celery, wash them and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Trim off the leaves and the ends. If a stalk is very wide, cut it in half lengthwise with a paring knife.
Cut each stalk into 4 pieces about 4 inches long, so you have 16 logs.
Spread the 1/2 cup peanut butter into the groove of each log with a butter knife, mounding it a little.
Press the 1/2 cup raisins into the peanut butter in a line along each log.
Serve them right away, or cover them and keep them in the fridge for up to 8 hours.
method_notes: Both versions fill celery with peanut butter and press raisins along the top. IzzyCooking (the lead, since neither page has 20 ratings) uses 4 celery sticks cut into 4 to 5 inch logs with 1/2 cup each of peanut butter and raisins, and says they hold in the fridge for up to 8 hours. Insanely Good uses 5 stalks with 1/2 cup peanut butter and only 1/4 cup raisins. This follows the lead's amounts, which make 16 logs, four per person.
